top_signals.title: 5 alternatives to Ledger to store your Bitcoin
top_signals.summary: Hardware wallets aren’t the only way to protect your crypto, but from ETFs and passkeys to multisig accounts, each alternative has its own risks and trade-offs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Big Tech’s eMudhra fixes may leave crypto bots exposed, CertiK warns
top_signals.summary: CertiK says crypto trading bots and exchange applications may remain exposed to the eMudhra certificate flaw because browser fixes may not protect all software.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: United ‘Still Solidly Profitable’ as Fuels Costs Rise, CEO Kirby Says
top_signals.summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby discusses the company’s ability to pass along higher fuel costs and seeing continued strength in customer demand. Kirby also shares his thoughts on a wealth tax and other US social and policy points on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: SpaceX stock jumps 8% after earnings beat and Musk hints at Tesla tie-up
top_signals.summary: SpaceX shares jumped after the company reported surging revenue growth in its third quarter, and owner Elon Musk floated a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger.
